items.title: Trump’s accounts traded up to $97.5 million in Nvidia as Huang gained White House access
items.summary: Trump’s accounts sold up to $1 million in Nvidia stock five days after he was briefed on Jensen Huang’s relationship with a suspected Chinese spy.
items.titleZh: 黄进入白宫后，特朗普在英伟达的账户交易额高达9750万美元
items.summaryZh: 特朗普的账户卖出了高达100万美元的英伟达股票，五天前，他听取了黄仁勋与一名疑似中国间谍的关系简报。

items.summary:

Four happened in driverless “Robotaxi” service, and none topped 5 mph. The other four happened with a test driv…
items.titleZh: 特斯拉Cybercab已经坠毁8次，数据显示速度问题
items.summaryZh: 特斯拉的Cybercab目前在美国国家公路交通安全管理局（NHTSA）备案了8起撞车事故，而就在两个月前，专门制造的自动驾驶出租车开始在奥斯汀提供公共交通服务。

items.title: Days after Microsoft and the FAA went dark, Chase and Wells Fargo customers can’t get to their money
items.summary: Chase blamed a “technical issue” as customers at several big U.S. banks reported trouble moving money on Monday.
items.titleZh: 在微软和美国联邦航空管理局陷入黑暗的几天后，大通和富国银行的客户无法获得他们的资金
items.summaryZh: 大通将此归咎于“技术问题”，因为美国几家大银行的客户周一报告称在转移资金方面遇到了问题。

items.title: Instagram Is Bringing Amazon Affiliate Links Directly to Reels and Posts
items.summary: The Meta-owned social media platform now lets creators attach up to 30 affiliate links per Reel to make money from Amazon more easily.
items.titleZh: Instagram将亚马逊联盟链接直接带到卷轴和帖子
items.summaryZh: Meta旗下的社交媒体平台现在允许创作者在每个Reel上附加多达30个联盟链接，以便更轻松地从亚马逊赚钱。

items.title: ‘Steve Jobs ruined everything with the iPhone’: Tech billionaire Palmer Luckey gets real on what really killed the 10,000-hour rule
items.summary: “I think the entire industry’s gone in completely the wrong direction,” he said. “Steve Jobs, love the guy, but it was the iPhone that started all of this.”
items.titleZh: “史蒂夫·乔布斯用iPhone毁了一切”：科技亿万富翁帕尔默·勒基（Palmer Luckey）说出了真正杀死一万小时规则的原因
items.summaryZh: 他说：“我认为整个行业都走错了方向。”。“史蒂夫·乔布斯，我爱他，但正是iPhone开启了这一切。”
